specific_waiting.value: 24 months Named Ailment waiting period (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.)

room_rent.value: No limit on Room Rent or ICU Charges in base policy (Optional Room Rent Modification to Single Private AC / Twin Sharing)

copay.value: No mandatory age co-payment in base wording

ayush.value: Covered up to Sum Insured in any AYUSH Hospital across Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy

daycare.value: All Day Care Treatments covered up to Sum Insured

pre_post.value: 60 days pre-hospitalisation and 180 days post-hospitalisation up to Sum Insured

ncb.value: Cumulative Bonus 50% per Policy Year up to 100% of Base Sum Insured (not reduced on claim); optional Cumulative Bonus Super up to 500%

sublimits.value: No room rent or ICU sub-limit; Road Ambulance covered up to Sum Insured
